tool.name: FASTA uppercase
tool.description: convert sequence lines to uppercase, discarding pre-existing soft-masking
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$input' #else cat '$input' #end if | awk -f '$__tool_directory__/fasta_uppercase.awk' > '$output'

param.name: input
param.label: Assembly FASTA
param.help: Plain or gzipped FASTA, soft-masked or unmasked.

tool.help:
**fasta_uppercase** converts every sequence line to uppercase and keeps FASTA header lines unchanged.
Sequence names are case-sensitive identifiers (for example, `scaffold_12` must not become `SCAFFOLD_12`).
In repeat-masking workflows, remove any prior soft-mask first so `bedtools maskfasta -soft` writes only the new repeat masks.
